title: A representable quotient map of an etale relation is etale and surjective
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $V,R$ be schemes over $S$. Let $j=(s,t):R\to V\times_S V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] be a monomorphism such that for every $S$-scheme $T$, $j$ identifies $R(T)$ with an equivalence relation on $V(T)$. Suppose $s,t$ are etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $F$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] of the presheaf $T\mapsto V(T)/R(T)$, with quotient map $q:h_V\to F$, where $h_V(T)=\operatorname{Mor}_S(T,V)$. Assume that $q$ is representable: for every $S$-scheme $T$ and section $x\in F(T)$, the sheaf $h_T\times_{x,F,q}h_V$ is represented by an $S$-scheme $P_x$. Then the projection $P_x\to T$ is etale and surjective for every $T,x$. More precisely, there is an fppf covering $\{f_\alpha:T_\alpha\to T\}$ and maps $a_\alpha:T_\alpha\to V$ with $q(a_\alpha)=x|_{T_\alpha}$, together with canonical isomorphisms over $T_\alpha$ $$P_x\times_T T_\alpha\simeq T_\alpha\times_{a_\alpha,V,t}R,$$ under which the map to $V$ is $s\circ\operatorname{pr}_R$. Moreover every $x\in F(T)$ lifts to $V$ on an etale covering [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]: there is a jointly surjective etale family $\{E_\beta\to T\}$ and maps $b_\beta:E_\beta\to V$ such that $q(b_\beta)=x|_{E_\beta}$. No representability of the diagonal of $F$, and no algebraic-space hypothesis on $F$, is assumed.

proof.text: Fix an S-scheme T and a section x of F(T). Prove local surjectivity of the specified universal unit η directly, without assuming a small-valued sheafification functor on the big site: let B be the subsheaf of F consisting of sections locally in the image of η. Its sheaf condition follows from the sheaf condition of F and transitivity of covering sieves. The map η factors through B. Its universal property gives l:F→B, and injectivity of precomposition with η shows l followed by B→F is the identity. Thus B=F. The presheaf coequalizer projection h_V→Q is pointwise surjective, so the composite q:h_V→F is locally surjective. The image sieve of x is covering. Transfer it to T.left using the slice-site sieve equivalence; extract an fppf covering presieve and express it as a family of arrows. Membership of each arrow in the image sieve supplies a map a_i:T_i→V with q(a_i)=x|T_i. These arguments are formalized in the proved private helpers universal_unit_locallySurjective and local_lifts.

source.place: Tag 02WV, lemma-when-it-works-it-works, first paragraph of proof; local sections: sites.tex Tag 00WK, lemma-sections-sheafification

proof.text: Use [lem-trf-etale-relation-kernel-pair] to obtain the pullback square h_R→h_V over q:h_V→F, with coordinates (s,t). Yoneda preserves pullbacks. Paste the square for P×_T T_i with the represented square for P, obtaining a pullback of q along h_{T_i}→h_T→F. Paste the square for T_i×_{a_i,V,t}R with the kernel-pair square; this is another pullback of q along the same map, since q(a_i)=x|T_i. Uniqueness of pullbacks gives an isomorphism of representable presheaves, and [lem-galois-yoneda-fully-faithful] recovers the scheme isomorphism e. The two pullback projection equations give e≫pr_Ti=pr_Ti and e≫pr_R≫s=pr_P≫b. Any other isomorphism with these equations has equal Yoneda image by joint monicity of the two projections of the second pasted pullback, hence equals e. This is the proved private helper local_model.

proof.text: The projection T_i×_{a_i,V,t}R→T_i is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change]. Transport this property through the local isomorphism of Step 2. The forgetful functor from schemes over S to schemes preserves pullbacks, so these are etale scheme base changes of p:P→T.

source.place: Tag 02WV, lemma-when-it-works-it-works, sentence beginning Since t is etale and surjective; morphisms.tex Tag 02GO, lemma-base-change-etale

proof.text: The fppf covering family of Step 1 is an fpqc covering by the existing Mathlib leaf [lem-trf-fppf-covering-is-fpqc], applied as Scheme.fppfPrecoverage_le_fpqcPrecoverage to its presieve of arrows. No affine refinement or restriction-of-open comparison is needed.

Apply [lem-galois-fpqc-descend-etale] to p.left and the fpqc family from Step 4. Identify the chosen scheme pullbacks with the underlying schemes of the slice pullbacks using their pullback isomorphisms, and use Step 3 to establish the hypothesis. For surjectivity a shorter argument avoids a separate reflexivity section: for each lift a_i the represented pullback universal property gives l_i:T_i→P with l_i≫p=f_i and l_i≫b=a_i, by Yoneda full faithfulness. Every point z of T lies below a point y of some T_i by the fppf-covering hypothesis. Then l_i(y) maps to z. Thus p is surjective.

source.place: Tag 02WV, lemma-when-it-works-it-works, final descent paragraph; descent.tex Tag 02VN, lemma-descending-property-etale

proof.text: Use the singleton family $\{E=P_x\xrightarrow{\pi}T\}$. By Step 5 it is jointly surjective and etale, hence an etale covering by [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The projection $b:P_x\to V$ is part of the represented fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. Its defining equality is $q(b)=x|_{P_x}$, so it is the required etale-local lift. The local models and their $s$-projection were already identified in Step 2. Since $T,x$ were arbitrary, every clause follows.

lean.statement: theorem representable_etale_quotient_presentation {S : Scheme.{u}} {R V : Over S} (s t : R ⟶ V) [Mono (prod.lift s t)] (hrel : ∀ T : Over S, Equivalence (fun a b : T ⟶ V ↦ ∃ r : T ⟶ R, r ≫ s = a ∧ r ≫ t = b)) [Etale s.left] [Etale t.left] (F : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η : coequalizer (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ⟶ F.obj) (hη : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun g : F.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η ≫ g)) (hrep : AlgebraicSpace.IsRepresentable (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η)) : ∀ (T : Over S) (x : F.obj.obj (op T)), (∀ (P : Over S) (p : P ⟶ T) (b : P ⟶ V), IsPullback (yoneda.map b) (yoneda.map p) (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η) (yonedaEquiv.symm x) → Etale p.left ∧ Surjective p.left ∧ ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (T' : I → Over S) (f : ∀ i, T' i ⟶ T) (a : ∀ i, T' i ⟶ V), Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ (T' i).left) (fun i ↦ (f i).left) ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage T.left ∧ ∀ i, (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η).app (op (T' i)) (a i) = F.obj.map (f i).op x ∧ ∃! e : pullback p (f i) ≅ pullback (a i) t, e.hom ≫ pullback.fst (a i) t = pullback.snd p (f i) ∧ e.hom ≫ pullback.snd (a i) t ≫ s = pullback.fst p (f i) ≫ b) ∧ (∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (E : I → Over S) (g : ∀ i, E i ⟶ T) (b : ∀ i, E i ⟶ V), Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ (E i).left) (fun i ↦ (g i).left) ∈ Scheme.etalePrecoverage T.left ∧ ∀ i, (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η).app (op (E i)) (b i) = F.obj.map (g i).op x)
